qualification_invariants: Discover actual runs by exact source SHA, repository and trusted workflow path, then require correct event/main branch and successful final run/attempt. Paginate API lists and retain unfiltered records so absence/truncation cannot look like completion.
For every mandatory job require successful original test/measure/compatibility/producer steps; artifact existence and an always-upload step alone never qualify a failed producer.
Use the final source workflow bytes for each job map. If source or workflow changes, refresh this plan rather than carrying old hashes or outcomes forward.
Preserve actual failures, cancellations and attempts; do not silently treat a rerun or newer source as evidence for an older source.
Counts from supporting workflows remain separate from native CTest totals, direct-model assertion counts and the13 stable validator lanes.
No numerical, synthetic or byte-compatibility fixture establishes hardware/acoustic equivalence.

actual_archive_checks: Inspect actual SOURCE_SHA256SUMS against git-show source bytes for every listed file, including the new filter, Engine, body and200-parameter definitions.
Verify BINARY_SHA256SUMS and all archive SHA256SUMS, raw CSVs, capture fixture identity and recorded build environment.
Require measured numerical regression bounds and parity-capture producer tests to pass.
dsp_provenance.compatibility_boundary: These immutable baselines deliberately test old default-off corpus and seven-tone source circuit/audio compatibility. They are not the newly reprogrammed factory bank and must not be described as all new presets sounding unchanged.

sanitizer_contract.note: Actual CI enables leak scanning; the local ptrace-limited direct-header sanitizer report is separate and cannot substitute for this full job.
sanitizer_contract.result_accounting: Require a nonempty current-source complete CTest inventory; record registered/passed/failed/formal-skipped counts and individual skips from original logs. Report nested Python skips separately. An exit-zero empty or truncated log is insufficient.

filter_batch_contract.artifact_policy: No dedicated upload in this workflow. Retain actual job API/logs and original CTest outcomes for all six matrix jobs.

screenshot_contract.required: Core check plus actual-editor --self-test must succeed; inspect screenshot provenance/source/run and PNG checksums. Failed capture artifacts remain failed evidence.
screenshot_contract.possible_main_write: Refresh repository screenshots compares origin/main with the triggering GITHUB_SHA. It may commit only docs/screenshots with message docs: refresh verified panel screenshots [skip ci] when source is still the head.
descendant_acceptance: Fetch and preserve the bot commit; verify its parent is the exact binary source and every changed path is under docs/screenshots.
Verify checked-in provenance names the triggering source/run and SHA256SUMS agree with PNGs.
If main moved first, an artifacts-only outcome is allowed; do not force or rewrite the branch.
A docs-only screenshot descendant does not change the accepted binary source. Final documentation publication must preserve that ancestry.

actual_followup_inputs: Exact published source SHA and tree
Downloaded artifact API objects/ZIP bytes or verified materialization references
limitations: Readiness plan only: all current-source execution, archive and screenshot publication facts remain pending.
Changed-path snapshot contains current tracked edits plus the known new filter header; re-evaluate if parent adds changes to excluded workflow/request paths.
No historical2026.11.3 counts/outcomes are copied into current qualification.
